'''''Rally's Daily Investor''''' was an investing publication. On 37:5:24 [[Great ReSynchronization|GrS]], [[Independent Traders' Infonet/Legends|Independent Traders' Infonet]] reported ''Rally's Daily Investor'' was estimating that 9,000 new system-wide [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities would enter full production during the course of the following fiscal quarter, in response to the demand created by the [[rawmat shortage of 1–2 ABY]].
